quotes.quote: Kimi K3 advances end-to-end knowledge work. Beyond public benchmarks, Kimi K3 (max) demonstrates consistent gains across our internal evaluations, which are derived from recurring patterns and challenges observed in real-world user-agent workflows.
The full model weights will be released by July 27, 2026. Further details on the architecture, training, and evaluations will be released alongside the Kimi K3 technical report.

All Kimi K3 results reported below are obtained with the reasoning effort set to 'max', setting temperature = 1.0 and top-p = 1.0. Depending on the benchmark, each model is evaluated under one of three agentic harnesses — Kimi Code, Claude Code, or Codex — as specified in the notes below.
Dominance scores are recomputed from the raw scores using the official evaluation script and are current as of July 16, 2026.
We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window.
Submitted on 27 Jul 2026 … last revised 7 Aug 2026
DECK Bench: measures the capability to produce high-quality presentation decks from task descriptions drawn from real usage scenarios.

Beyond the public benchmark suite, we maintain a collection of in-house benchmarks that target capability areas public evaluations do not adequately cover, giving a more comprehensive measure of model and agent capabilities.
These benchmarks are refreshed and expanded frequently, so that they can closely track the model's evolving failure modes and directly guide data and training iterations.
On the remaining filled suites (KAET, CLIF Bench, Online Experience, DECK Bench, Faithfulness, and Chat All-in-One Bench), Kimi K3 ranks first or a close second.
Table 3: Results on our in-house benchmarks.
Unless otherwise noted, models are evaluated at maximum reasoning effort (GPT-5.5 at xhigh); harness assignments are shown in the Harness column.
DECKBench (Jang et al., 2026) evaluates academic slide generation and multi-turn slide editing with instruction-following criteria.
